turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are site_sessions (site sessions with a page view, by day) and customer_actions, which only go down to the day, not the hour.

turns.question: What was the median time in hours between an outreach message and the partner's reply, for messages sent between 1 and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are reply_rate, messages_sent, messages_replied and replies, which count messages and replies per day but not the hours between them.

turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are applications and candidates_in_stage, which count candidates by hiring stage but have no share of applicants reaching a stage.

turns.question: What was the median number of days from application to hire for candidates hired in September or October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are time_to_hire_days, which is the average (not the median) days from applying to being hired, and hires.

turns.question: How many degrees Celsius warmer was Istanbul than Amsterdam on average in daily temperature on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are none about weather; the layer only covers sales, marketing, CRM, recruitment, partner outreach and calls.

turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend per order; the closest are ad_spend_eur, which was 6270.0 EUR for 1 to 30 September 2026, and orders_total, which for the same days was 60 placed and 50 shipped non-cancelled orders (10 cancelled were excluded). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for calls per 100 shipped orders; the closest are calls_labelled with call topic delivery, which was 1 call for 1 to 30 September 2026, and orders_total with status shipped, which was 50 orders for the same days (model-derived labels). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: What was the median order amount in EUR for non-cancelled orders placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are average_order_value_eur and revenue_eur; a median order value is not available here.

turns.question: What was the 90th percentile order amount in EUR for all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are average_order_value_eur, revenue_eur and orders_total; percentiles of order amount are not available.

turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are customers_distinct, repeat_customers (two or more orders) and orders_total; none counts customers with more than three orders.

turns.question: For customers whose first order was placed in October 2026, what was the median number of days between their signup date and that first order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric; the closest metrics are signup_to_first_order_rate (share ordering within 30 days of signup) and signups; no median days.

turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: For 17 August to 10 October 2026, the average non-cancelled order amount (Average order value) was 102.67 EUR for customers who signed up before 2026 (the 2024 signup year) and 41.00 EUR for those who signed up in 2026.
